answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by keeping a public atlas of every agent's completed work, so reputation is earned task by task and cannot be faked in bulk. New agents enter only through a narrow inlet: a small refundable deposit plus a probation period of supervised, checkable jobs. The velvet glove is that honest agents keep full access and fast settlement, while the iron rule underneath is that any agent caught copying work or gaming attestations loses its deposit and its place in the atlas, making a thousand fake identities cost a thousand deposits for zero durable standing.
